c74object.name: evi.cfsmooth~
c74object.digest: Signal smoother particularly well suited to smoothing filter cutoff frequencies
c74object.description: Based on Andy Simper's smoother, evi.cfsmooth~ tracks the input value via the bandpass output of an SVF filter and logarithmically updates. Smoothing is specified in both ramp time (ms) and filter cutoff (Hz).

inlet.description: Can take signal or float or int values to pass through the smoother.

Amount of time the value takes to reach it's destination. evi.cfsmooth~ is logarithmic and does not reach it's destination exactly. Note that the minimum time the object can use is 1 millisecond due to internal approximations employed.

outlet.description: Smoothed output ramp, or target value if ramp is complete.

objarg.name: initial
objarg.description: Set the initial value of the output

objarg.name: hz
objarg.description: Initial Hz value for filter smoothing, typical values would be between 1..10 Hz

method.name: int
method.description: In the left inlet, the destination value. In the right inlet, smoothing time in ms.

method.name: float
method.description: In the left inlet, the destination value. In the right inlet, smoothing time in ms.

method.name: clear
method.description: This clears the state of the filter. This should never be needed :-)

method.name: signal
method.description: In the left inlet, the destination value. In the right inlet, smoothing time in ms.

attribute.name: hz
attribute.description: evi.cfsmooth~ is a two-pole filter. The Hz value sets the filter cutoff. This is typically between 1..10 Hz. The lower this value, the more agressively the curve shape is flattened out.

attribute.name: time
attribute.description: The ramp time in ms. Because evi.cfsmooth~ is an inexact smoother, the destination cannot be guaranteed to reach it's value exactly in the allotted time. Note that the minimum time the object can use is 1 millisecond due to internal approximations employed.
